cohort: 6634 singleton and 2680 twin infants born before 32 weeks gestation admitted to neonatal intensive care units (NICUs) in the Chinese Neonatal Network (CHNN) between January 2019 and December 2019
finding: Compared to singletons, twins had higher mortality rates, higher incidences of RDS and BPD, more surfactant usage, and longer NICU stays.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight of 1333.70 g for singletons and 1294.63 g for twins
